claim_summary: For fixed positive physical parameters, stationary central-window counts in a simultaneously reset Ornstein--Uhlenbeck gas have a sharp Gaussian equilibrium-edge crossover with overall probability scale \(N^{-r/(4\mu)}\).
scientific_integrity: Conditional-independent stationary law and quantitative binomial boundary-layer limit proved in supplied text; finite numerical integration is illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive parameters and a centered finite interval. Neither joint zero-reset/trap limits nor interacting gases nor other reset protocols are claimed. Implicit prior generic binomial-mixture coverage remains a literature risk.
title: Sharp finite-size counting edge in a harmonically confined resetting gas
